scripts.dev: pnpm run ensure-deps && (PORT=3000 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev &) && PORT=8080 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/ccna-learning run dev
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build:dev: pnpm run ensure-deps && PORT=8080 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/ccna-learning run build
scripts.ensure-deps: test -d artifacts/ccna-learning/node_modules/.bin && test -d artifacts/api-server/node_modules/esbuild || pnpm install --prefer-offline
